text: Following Documents are required for Ad-hoc permission for manufacture and sale of cement (all types) 1. Application addressed to Under Secretary, Cement Section, Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi - 110 011. 2. Copy of BIS Application. 3. Copy of SSI/IEM/Provisional/Permanent Registration. 4. Copy of No Objection Certificate/Consent to Operate issued by State Pollution Control Board. 5. List of Plant and Machinery. 6. List of Test Equipment. 7. BIS recommendation letter. 8. Undertaking on the letter head of the company as under: (to be printed on company letter head) UNDERTAKING During the period till we get ISi Certification Mark, we will not manufacture cement, which does not conform to the prescribed standard and will keep proper testing Records for inspection by the concerned authorities. In case we fail to get BIS License, on account of sample failure, we will stop the commercial sale of the cement already produced and the same will be destroyed immediately and the matter will be reported to the State authorities under intimation to BIS and your Department. ~':\ ·9·2o~~ ture Name & Designation I IOr PIR in JPAROEEPKUMAR KHER I .~~• 1U.nder Secretary -ffl!R~ .~ /Mln. otC.&I.
